messages:
Maria: tiny shoutout — the mailroom just left a stack of handwritten thank-you notes and cookies for infra. ❤️
Jamal: wait what?? where??
Maria: lobby table by the lost-and-found, sandwich board says "kudos". go grab one before lunch :cookie:
Sasha: who sent them?
Maria: card says "Product team appreciation" no name. very wholesome.
Leo: bless. can we leave a little thank-you note back? also, please please don't hoard them :sweat_smile:
Amelia: putting together a tiny sticker pack (tiny trophy emojis) to leave with the notes. i'll swing by mailroom in 10.
Rachel: @Maria can we do a 2-min shoutout at All-Hands today? quick face to camera to say thanks.
Jamal: live shoutout poll: 3pm All-Hands? react with :thumbsup: for yes, :hourglass_flowing_sand: for later
Maria: :thumbsup:
Sasha: :thumbsup:
Leo: :thumbsup:
Amelia: :thumbsup: also bringing stickers labeled `TROPHY-03`
Rachel: perfect — i'll add a 2-min slot at 3.
OpsBot: Reminder: All-Hands at 3:00 PM (link) — don't forget to mute if you're eating :grimacing:
Jamal: cookie run assembled. maria, i'll take a few to the east wing.
Maria: thank you!! leaving a sticky that says "Do not hoard — share the cookies" :laughing:
Sasha: photo? would love to post in #social after
Amelia: snapped one — uploading to #random in a sec :camera_with_flash:
Jamal: small but feels big. love it. :heart:
Rachel: agreed. micro-gestures are everything. see y'all at 3.
